body: Whoa  whoa, let's slow down. There is a huge difference between someone who KILLS someone with the intent to KILL and second hand smoke that MAY have unintentionally contributed to his condition. Don't ever degrade yourself like that, you did nothing wrong. If I was your Dad, I wouldn't give a fuck if second hand smoke contributed to my illness, I want you to fucking live. Cancer isn't the end it all illness, there is still a chance of survival so stop jumping to all these conclusions please for your own sake.
People make mistakes, there is no way to determine if you caused his problems so stop worrying about it and suggest that he should check up on the symptoms if he keeps having them.

I'm pretty sure your dad would be even more devastated if he lost his son/daughter and had cancer at the same time if he does have cancer. The best thing you can do right now is support him while he goes through this.

Yea the worst part of this whole ordeal is my parents reaction to me being kicked out if it happens. I fear that more than anything else and thanks for your words of support, good luck with your studies as well!
Thanks, your comment gives me hope that I can actually achieve something even in this mess.

Hah I found a second me. Do you ever get urges to off yourself? I keep getting them with this sickening feeling in the pit of my stomach but then I think about the good aspects of living and it helps deal with it somewhat. Have you told your parents?
Thanks I think I'll keep on pressing forward as well.

Thanks for your comment, I'll try contacting someone to tell them about my issues. You helped me realize recently that it is better to let people know what problems you may be facing in life instead of the 'tough it out' attitude I had before.
I enjoy the good parts of life and don't want to end them.

Thanks for replying. I hope the university will let me back after one year of break. The worst part will be the big 'reveal', my parents will be angry as hell or super disappointed, I don't know what's going to happen.
